source: User traceback and Windows UI Automation text from the open Colab page. This is a diagnostic record, not the original subprocess raw log.
message: This Python installation is managed by uv and should not be modified.
cause: Path.resolve() dereferenced .colab-venv/bin/python to uv's managed base interpreter, losing virtual environment context.
fix: Invoke the literal venv interpreter path, check sys.prefix != sys.base_prefix before installing packages, and keep retry logs in separate directories.
